content.what_it_is: Fixed-form Fortran utility (unnamed main program) that converts FUNWAVE grid-A station output into a nested-run coupling.txt boundary file for the sph_nesting benchmark. Hardwired input block (comments L32-55): nsta=3, nwest=3, nsouth=neast=nnorth=0 (L34-38), time_cut=0.0 (L41; 10-hour alternative commented L42), refinement iscale=2 (L43), J_START_*=1 (L45-48), J_TRIM_*=0 (L50-53). Refined boundary point counts Nsm_side=(nside-1)*iscale+1 (L57-60, echoed L62-63). Reads stations sequentially from fdir='../grid_A/' (L66) in the order east, west, south, north (comment L68): builds 4-digit file names sta_NNNN by digit decomposition of a running icount (L73-82 etc.), reads time,z,u,v rows until EOF (east L84-89 end=301, west L112-117 end=101, south L141-146 end=200, north L168-173 end=201), setting Ndata=ktime-1 each time. Construction loop (L183-245): for each coarse interval I, fills refined points III=II..II+iscale with tmp=(III-II)/iscale linear weights between station I and I+1 for Z/U/V per side (west L186-197, east L201-212, south L215-227, north L230-242). Time-cut search Kstart (L251-254). Output (L257-321): coupling.txt header 'coupling data'/'boundary info: num of points, start point' with per-side counts Nsm-J_TRIM-J_START+1 and start points (L258-267), then 'TIME SERIES': for each K=Kstart..Ndata writes TIME(K) and per side 'EAST SIDE'/'WEST SIDE'/'SOUTH SIDE'/'NORTH SIDE' with U, V, Z rows in FORMAT 119 (5E16.6, L269) over I=J_START..Nsm-J_TRIM (L272-317). Unused FORMAT 100 (999E16.5) at L319.

verbatim_spans.text: ! order should be east, west, south, north

unresolved: tmp=(III-II)/iscale (L189, repeated L204, L219, L234) is integer/integer division assigned to a real: tmp is 0 for all III<II+iscale and 1 only at III=II+iscale, so the intended linear interpolation degenerates to piecewise-constant (nearest-coarse-point) refinement -- likely bug.

For sides with n=0 (south/east/north here) Nsm_side=(0-1)*iscale+1=-1 (L57-60), so the header writes -1-0-1+1=-1 points for those sides (L261-267); whether FUNWAVE's COUPLING reader tolerates negative counts is external to this file.
Ndata is overwritten by each side's read loop (L90, L118, L147, L174) -- the last active side's record count wins; sides with different lengths would silently truncate/extend.

The refinement loop covers III=II..II+iscale inclusive (L188), writing the shared endpoint twice for consecutive I; icount-based sta_NNNN numbering assumes the station file order east->west->south->north matches how mk_station.m generated them ('order should be east, west, south, north' L68 vs the grid_A script's west+south legs).
nsta (L34) is unused; implicit typing throughout (no IMPLICIT NONE); FORMAT 100 (L319) unused.
